svg.text: Casino Open Sign V2 - parts: strips, pixel numbers and cutting list
2 strips, 28 pixels = 2.8 m of 12 V WS2811 strip (30 LEDs per metre, 1 pixel = 10 cm); 11 Grove sticks of 10 LEDs.
Cut the strip only at the cut marks (between two pixels). Both strips are single pieces: no joints.
1-6 C A S I N O, 7-10 N E P O (reversed)
2.8 m of one 5 m reel (50 pixels): 2.2 m left over
Frame strip (D11): pixel numbers (front view, counter-clockwise)
pixel 1 = lower-left corner, pixel 6 = lower-right corner
pixel 10 = upper-right corner, pixel 15 = upper-left corner
Frame light, arrow right: start pixel 15 (upper left), end pixel 6 (lower right).
Frame light, arrow left: start pixel 10 (upper right), end pixel 1 (lower left).
Letters strip (D12): one pixel per letter
The strip order is C A S I N O N E P O: the OPEN letters are wired in REVERSED order (O is the last pixel).
The program maps every letter to its pixel, so all patterns run in reading order for the viewer.
Grove sticks: 10 arrow sticks + the CLOSED light (in the shield, not cut)
Stick body 83 x 10 mm, LED window 74 x 4 mm; arrow geometry and drill template: ../arrow_sticks/.
